title: Right Number, Wrong Man: A Masked Man, Hate-to-Love Dark Romantic Comedy (Southern Sinners
description: Colton Walker has been secretly obsessed with Hailey Morgan for sixteen years. She has hated him for just as long after a misunderstanding cast him as the enemy in her story and she married his good-for-nothing brother. Heartbroken, Colton ran. When family drama drags him back to the small town he fled, Colton discovers that his brother has been cheating on Hailey. Naturally, he sees only one solution: To kill his brother and frame it as a street robbery. Colton vows to keep his distance from Hailey, but when she accidentally sends him a spicy video, his self-control snaps. He slips into the role of Jax, her anonymous, masked Dom to finally claim the woman who despises him. Hailey is desperate to explore every dark fantasy she suppressed in her loveless marriage. The arrival of Jax is the perfect, dangerous fix—he's pierced, muscled, and knows exactly how to push her limits. Her only complication is Colton, her dead husband’s brother, whose presence is a constant, bitter reminder of her past. Yet, the more time she spends arguing with him, the more she realizes he might not be the villain she always believed. Soon, Hailey is falling for a man with two identities: the one she can't stand and the one she absolutely can't resist.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_5"]', '#CardInstanceGyNXUm3ldpLV-QbKAvrYHw')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_5',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);hei

title: Wrong Number, Right Guy (The Bourbon Street Boys Book 1)
description: When a mysterious text message summons May Wexler to a biker bar in downtown New Orleans, she knows something is very wrong. title: Wrong Number, Right Man (Iron Vow MC)
description: I thought the worst part of my night was the bad date. I was wrong. Dane Voss was charming in the way dangerous men usually are, with a pretty smile, too many personal questions, and the kind of confidence that made my instincts scream before my brain caught up. I left before dessert. He followed. By the time I locked myself in a gas station bathroom, there were three men outside the door and my hands were shaking too badly to think straight. I tried to text my best friend my location, his name, anything that might help if they got inside. But I sent the message to the wrong number. Unknown: Who is this? I should have apologized and stopped texting. Then the stranger asked the one question that made my blood run cold. Unknown: Is he still outside? I never told him there was a man outside. His name was Roman “Rook” Hale, president of Iron Vow MC, and he sent his men for me like my fear was a debt he already owed. I didn’t know him. I didn’t trust him. And I definitely didn’t understand why a man like him looked at me like surviving wasn’t something I needed to apologize for. Roman is dangerous. Possessive. Ruthless. The kind of man people cross the street to avoid. But when Dane comes back for me, Roman makes one thing terrifyingly clear. I may have texted the wrong number. But I reached the right man. Wrong Number, Right Man is a dark wrong-number MC romance featuring a possessive outlaw biker, touch-her-and-die protection, found family, danger, healing, and a heroine learning that love should never feel like a cage. This book is a standalone with a HEA.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_7"]', '#CardInstance3oqnT-lil0XxnbW2BuQ_-Q')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_7',{wb: 1})}

title: Wrong Number, Right Grumpy Sheriff
description: HOPE I moved to Saddle Creek for a quiet, charming life. Instead, my smartwatch keeps summoning the new sheriff. More often than I'd like to admit. But when a storm washes out the road and strands him in my kitchen, I discover the man determined to keep his distance isn't nearly as immune as he pretends. Turns out the wrong number found exactly the right man. title: Wrong Number, Right Grump (Wrong Number, Right Guy)
description: Wrong number. Right timing. I left my ex the world’s most unhinged breakup voicemail—complete with colorful language, a few creative threats, and a playlist he could shove where the sun doesn’t shine. Only…I vented to the wrong number. Worse? The stranger listened to my rambling rant and had the nerve to respond. With sarcasm, brutal honesty, and a surprising amount of patience for my mortifying meltdown. Things should’ve ended there. But I can’t stop texting him. I overshare and ramble. He replies with clipped answers that drive me absolutely insane. We’re nothing alike. And yet I’m hooked. And when we finally meet face to face? Let’s just say this wrong number might be the right guy after all. A short, steamy, laugh-out-loud, instalove romance with mistaken identity, grumpy x sunshine instant attraction, and a cinnamon roll hero who falls first and harder. One misdialed call, accidental text, or late-night drunk dial sparks instant attraction, unexpected chemistry, and a whole lot of trouble. From grumpy mountain men to handsome hockey players, and smoking hot firemen, each wrong number leads to the right kind of love connection. Your next obsession is calling. title: The Right Wrong Number
description: JULIAN A year after his husband dies in a car accident, Julian is still uncertain how to navigate a future he'd planned for two until his eccentric friend Nora insists he needs to start moving on. Little does he know, there's someone at the end of the line that may end up giving him a second chance at both life and love. LIAM Liam is tired of living his sad bachelor life. In an attempt to move on from his meaningless hookups, he changes his phone number. When he suddenly starts getting texts from "Jules", he's delighted by his instant connection to the amiable stranger.
